author: Ankit
problem: A journal is a list of (date, note) entries with dates written as 'YYYY-MM-DD'. Return True if no entry is dated earlier than the entry before it.
bug_description: Uses <= when comparing neighbouring dates, so two notes on the same day are reported as out of order.

comments.accurate: True if the journal never goes back in time from one entry to the next
comments.wrong_behavior: True if each entry is dated after the one before it
comments.wrong_location: Date comparison verified; make sure the first entry isn't compared with anything
